Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer states that Gone with the Wind was released "about six years later" after Prohibition ended, even specifying "six years and ten days." The Ground Truth Answer is "6 years." The essential information—that 6 years elapsed between the end of Prohibition and the release of Gone with the Wind—is present in the Predicted Answer. The additional detail in the Predicted Answer does not contradict or omit any of the vital facts of the Ground Truth Answer.

Decision: TRUE
